market_question: Will the Carolina Hurricanes win the 2026 NHL Stanley Cup?
reasoning: Even the strongest NHL teams command future Cup odds around 10-12%, and the Hurricanes, though a solid contender, do not justify a 37.5% chance two seasons out. The long horizon adds roster uncertainty, injury risk, and playoff variability, pushing the true probability well below 10%.
evidence_points: Sportsbook futures markets typically price the top favorite at +800 to +1200 (7.7%-11.1% implied) a season ahead, never near 37%
The 2026 Cup is two full seasons away, amplifying variance and reducing any team's single-year probability
Carolina’s recent playoff exits (ECF loss in 2023, second-round exit in 2024) show they are competitive but far from a prohibitive favorite
sources_consulted: Historical NHL futures odds from major sportsbooks
Carolina Hurricanes roster, cap situation, and playoff performance 2022-2024
General principle of long-horizon championship probability estimation
